name: Cyient Ltd
title: Cyient Ltd - 532175 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Cyient Semiconductors raising INR300 crore (INR200cr debt, INR100cr equity) at INR4,650cr valuation; supply-side signal is capital being raised for fabless build-out, with no capacity or utilisation data and breakeven slipping to late FY27/early FY28.

triggers.label: Breakeven slips to late FY27/early FY28
triggers.quote: for now, we are still looking at a breakeven late FY27, early FY28. But based on the investor conversations, we'll come back.

triggers.label: External funding INR300cr at INR4,650cr valuation
triggers.quote: a total of INR300 crore s with equity valuation at INR4,650 crores from EAAA Alternatives

triggers.label: Parent commitment up to $100m; ~$30m deployed
triggers.quote: We've already put in about $30 million. So, rest of the money is available.

guidance.quote: for now, we are still looking at a breakeven late FY27, early FY28.
Cyient is also committed to our original investment thesis of up to $100 million

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are still looking at a breakeven late FY27, early FY28.

red_flags.label: Debt-funded Kinetic acquisition, ~$100m on subsidiary balance sheet
red_flags.quote: That's right, 80 plus 20, 100 in total on semiconductor balance sheet.

red_flags.label: Valuation 6-7x revenue, self-referenced
red_flags.quote: This valuation roughly works out to be 6x revenue to 7x revenue, depending on which revenue we consider

red_flags.label: Breakeven target softened
red_flags.quote: But based on the investor conversations, we'll come back.

evasions.quote: We can't disclose the rate because we're still not close to deal.
I mean in the lighter vein and say we'll get to EBIT profitability first
obviously, Navitas will be in a better position to comment for the NVIDIA side of the equation.
